title: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B: Shrinking a 120B Model Without Retraining From Scratch
hook: NVIDIA compressed its 120B-A12B Nemotron model down to 75B-A9B using 'Iterative Puzzle,' a post-training framework aimed at squeezing more inference efficiency out of an already-trained model.
key_points: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B is derived from the larger Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B, not trained from scratch.
Iterative Puzzle is NVIDIA's post-training compression framework: it shrinks the parent model while aiming to preserve downstream accuracy.
Architecture is a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts with interleaved Mamba, MoE, and Attention layers.
Supports Multi-Token Prediction (MTP), like its Nemotron-3-Super parent, for faster generation.
Goal: better inference efficiency for interactive, reasoning-heavy, and long-context workloads.
content_html: Making a big model smaller usually means retraining from scratch. NVIDIA's Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B instead takes an already-trained 120B model and compresses it after the fact.
extra_html: The model is derived from Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B using Iterative Puzzle, NVIDIA's post-training compression framework, shrinking it to 75B total parameters with 9B active per token while aiming to preserve downstream accuracy. Architecturally it's a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts that interleaves Mamba (state-space), MoE, and Attention layers, and — like its parent — supports Multi-Token Prediction for faster generation. NVIDIA's stated goal is better inference efficiency specifically for interactive, reasoning-heavy, and long-context workloads. Released on Hugging Face; reported on r/LocalLLaMA, 2026-07-07.
